scripts.minify:win: terser dest/quill.bundled.js --compress --mangle --output dest/quill.min.js && bun build dest/quill.min.js --compile --target bun-windows-x64 --outfile quill.exe
scripts.minify:linux: terser dest/quill.bundled.js --compress --mangle --output dest/quill.min.js && bun build dest/quill.min.js --compile --target bun-linux-x64 --outfile quill-linux
scripts.minify:mac: terser dest/quill.bundled.js --compress --mangle --output dest/quill.min.js && bun build dest/quill.min.js --compile --target bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile quill-mac
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run bundle && npm run minify:win && npm run minify:linux && npm run minify:mac
